candidates.how_to_enable: The account holder signs in to Hugging Face, reads the terms on the model page, confirms they are entitled to accept them, accepts, and records name and UTC date in this file; then pull a quantised build, load it into Ollama under the model name above and run tools/ai/model_candidate.py compare.
candidates.notes: A developer model: the publisher says it is not clinical-grade and needs validation for each use. It may be more eager to give clinical advice; the no-advice and dose-policy rejections are part of the comparison. Pulled 25 Oct 2026 as medgemma:4b (3.3 GB, text and image input).
